candidates.quote: Quarry Row Homes LP shall keep eighteen (18) of the ninety (90) apartments as income-restricted apartments.
An income-restricted apartment may be rented only to a household whose income is at or below sixty percent of area median income.
The monthly rent for an income-restricted apartment, with utilities, may not be more than thirty percent of sixty percent of area median income for the household size.
Sections 2 through 4 stay in force through December 31, 2055.
Quarry Row Homes LP and each successor in title are bound by this Agreement.
candidates.value: Quarry Row Homes LP and successors

candidates.quote: Every year by April 15, Quarry Row Homes LP shall send the City a rent roll showing the income and rent for each income-restricted apartment.
If a violation continues for more than 45 days after notice, the City may end the assessment freeze and bill the taxes that were not collected.
candidates.value: end assessment freeze and bill taxes

candidates.quote: The City shall hold the taxable value of the parcel at its 2025 level for ten years.
